descriptions.inProgress: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 wants you to help him eliminate some monsters that have been taking over the harbor. Specifically, 50 Overlord A and 40 Overlord B monsters.
descriptions.completed: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 asked you to help him eliminate some monsters, so you eliminated Overlord A and Overlord B monsters.
